analysis.corpus_reuse: historical corpus previously examined for v1, including its evaluation results
analysis.corpus_split: by author, preserving the published v1 split
analysis.interval: Wilson 95 per cent, descriptive because passages share authors and prefixes share passages
analysis.prefix_rule: shortest original-text prefix ending at a token reaching the named distinct-pair count
analysis.selection: all eligible passages reported, unavailable lengths counted as exclusions
analysis.unit: one verdict per source passage within each length group

controlled_removal.selection: lowest resulting z among reviewed alternatives in unused slots
controlled_removal.ties: slot index then authored candidate order

many.method: confusable substitution of the first eligible character in every tenth scored token
many.rationale: A token editing rate of about 0.1, which is the rate the NDSS 2026 character-level attack paper uses. One character changes almost nothing; this is what an actual attack looks like.

previous_attempt.reason: candidate review missed a empty and a additional article agreement

seed_policy: commit registration before one recorded draw, retain its outcomes, refuse a second draw

threshold_policy.selection: smallest threshold meeting target separately in each eligible calibration group
